label: Residential water use
unit: gallons per capita per day (residential potable)
description: Residential drinking-water use in gallons per person per day for the town's water system, 2022 data. Potable water only, so towns that also use a separate irrigation system (such as Lehi and Saratoga Springs) look lower than they are. West Valley City, Millcreek, Cottonwood Heights, and Holladay use a nearby system's figure.
source: Utah Division of Water Resources, Municipal & Industrial Water Use 2022
